name: iot-jobs-data
description: IoT Jobs is a service that allows you to define a set of jobs — remote operations that are sent to and executed on one or more devices connected to Amazon Web Services IoT Core.

subcommands.name: describe-job-execution
subcommands.description: Gets details of a job execution.

subcommands.name: get-pending-job-executions
subcommands.description: Gets the list of all jobs for a thing that are not in a terminal status.

subcommands.name: start-command-execution
subcommands.description: Using the command created with the CreateCommand API, start a command execution on a specific device.

subcommands.name: start-next-pending-job-execution
subcommands.description: Gets and starts the next pending (status IN_PROGRESS or QUEUED) job execution for a thing.

subcommands.name: update-job-execution
subcommands.description: Updates the status of a job execution.
